title: Thangigagi
desc: Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.

title: Bhanda Alla Bahaddur
desc: Following a misunderstanding, Krishna's grandfather throws him out of the house. His life takes a huge turn when he moves to the town and gets married to a rich girl.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.
